title: Transforming Error Types
goal: Convert a ParseIntError into a String error when returning Result.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Option and Result

hints: s.parse produces ParseIntError, but parse_port returns String as its error type.
Use map_err to convert the error before propagating with ?
explanation: The `?` operator fails with `E0277` when error types do not match and no `From` conversion exists. Calling `.map_err(|e| e.to_string())` converts `ParseIntError` into `String` so `?` can return `Err(String)`. Calling `.unwrap()` panics on invalid input instead of returning an error.
